title: coap_slot_coord.c calls lichen_wall_clock_* with no CONFIG_LICHEN_CCP_TIME_SYNC guard
description: Found during b7z9.8.1 review. coap_slot_coord.c:1482-1484 calls lichen_wall_clock_get()/lichen_wall_clock_valid() unguarded, but the declarations in link.h:837-844 are inside #ifdef CONFIG_LICHEN_CCP_TIME_SYNC and time_sync.c only compiles under that symbol (link/CMakeLists.txt:46). LICHEN_CCP_TIME_SYNC defaults y under LICHEN_LINK_CCP16_LOAD_BALANCING, so normal configs link; any config with SLOT_COORD=y but CCP_TIME_SYNC=n fails at compile (implicit declaration) or link. Same class of gap just fixed for coap_dtn.c in 9488b44e05 (guard + fail-open). Fix: #ifdef the calls with a clockless fallback (now_unix=0, valid=false) or add a Kconfig depends.
